maya: quick Q during the billing section 
- how do rate limits and quotas interact for trial vs paid customers?

nate: short: rate limits = RPS/concurrency enforced live; quotas = tokens/embeddings per billing period. trial gets lower quotas and tighter rate limits.

maya: are quotas shared across endpoints? e.g., embeddings + chat?

soph: we implemented separate quota lines. embeddings and generation tokens are tracked separately. some bundled plans may give pooled credits though.

ryan: what happens when you hit a quota mid-flow? do we surface an in-app upgrade CTA?

billing-bot: system: trials receive console modal + email when quota >= 90% used; requests exceeding hard quota return 402 or 429 depending on configuration.

maya: 402? we usually do 429. why 402 sometimes?

nate: 402 used when billing balance insufficient and auto-upgrade failed; 429 is pure rate limit/quota throttling.

maya: any auto-charge behavior? need to document for customer success.

soph: we do NOT auto-charge trial customers. for paid accounts with card on file, we have an option to allow "auto-topup" for quota add-ons (opt-in). ops/sales must enable for pilots.

maya: can promo credits increase quota?

ryan: credits affect invoice balance, not quota. theree28084a0is a manual flow to map credits -> temporary quota increases for strategic customers.

maya: error payloads 
- do we standardize error codes across SDKs?

nate: yes. 429 -> {"error":"rate_limit_exceeded","retry_after":int}. quota -> {"error":"quota_exceeded","retry_after":int,"quota_type":"tokens|embeddings"}. 402 -> {"error":"insufficient_funds"}.

maya: perfect. can we add an X-Remaining-Quota header? our mobile SDK team asked for it.

soph: feasible. prefer an opt-in header for privacy. and an authenticated /v1/usage endpoint for admin keys.

maya: notes for follow-up: document header + endpoint in API reference, add on-call playbook for quota spikes, and update trial email wording.

all-hands-bot: follow-ups created: #2001 api-docs:quota-headers, #2002 onboarding:quota-playbook, #2003 marketing:trial-email-copy

maya: thanks everyone. dropping this in the doc thread as well.
